briefdescription.para: macros to simplify declaration of members to trace

memberdef.name: declare_method_process_cl
memberdef.initializer: { \ ::sc_core::sc_spawn_options opt; \ opt.dont_initialize(); \ opt.spawn_method(); \ ::sc_core::sc_process_handle handle = ::sc_core::sc_spawn(func, name, &opt); \ this->sensitive << handle; \ this->sensitive_pos << handle; \ this->sensitive_neg << handle; \ }

memberdef.name: declare_thread_process_cl
memberdef.initializer: { \ ::sc_core::sc_spawn_options opt; \ ::sc_core::sc_process_handle handle = ::sc_core::sc_spawn(func, name, &opt); \ this->sensitive << handle; \ this->sensitive_pos << handle; \ }
